calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'

SELECT o.status, (f.store_key IS NOT NULL) AS x, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nodispatch,
 MIN(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS mind, MAX(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS maxd
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900
GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group='web') OR s.store_id=900 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 0 AS ret, f.net_amount AS gross_before
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, r.refund_net, 0
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, SUM(n.gross_before) AS before_returns, SUM(n.ret) AS returns,
  (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales q JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=q.business_date WHERE q.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) AS rpt_ctrl
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
